description: Returns the jukebox state: the record playing now with who picked it, the records waiting in line, and how many visitors are in the room by door (web, api, mcp). Takes no parameters. Call it before play_jukebox to see the queue. Read only.
name: whats_playing

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.

title: What's playing
